about_the_game:
Leaforia is a cozy farming simulation game set in a charming village filled with exploration and crafting. In this demo, you’ll experience basic farming, resource gathering, simple alchemy, combat, and meet three main NPCs.

Demo features:

  • Basic farming mechanics and resource collection

  • Simple alchemy system for creating potions

  • Combat system

  • Meet and interact with three main NPCs

  • Relaxing, atmospheric soundtrack

A short story segment introduces the core mechanics and culminates in an attack on a lumberjack camp.
